test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Matriculation Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: An item costs Rs15,000. A customer can choose either 30% discount or the buy two get one free offer. Jeevan chose the first offer and Rakshit chose the second offer. Find the difference in their payment for a single item.
solution:
**Given:**

An item costs ₹15,000. A customer can choose either 30% discount or the buy two get one free offer.

**Formula used:**

Discount price = Original price - (Discount % × Original price)

Buy two get one free offer price per item = (Total price for 3 items) / 3

**Calculations:**

For Jeevan:

Discount = 30%

Original price = ₹15,000

⇒
